title: RBI One-Time Approval Proposal for MFs & Insurers to Acquire up to 10% Bank Shareholding
summary: Replaces repeated prior approval requirement for qualifying institutional investors acquiring >5% bank stakes.

blocks.content: Replaces repeated prior approval requirement for qualifying institutional investors acquiring >5% bank stakes.

items: One-Time Approval: One-time RBI clearance covers future acquisitions up to 10% voting rights/share capital.
Qualifying Entities: SEBI-registered MFs, IRDAI-registered Insurers, PFRDA-registered Pension Funds.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Standard RBI major shareholding threshold in banks is 5%.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Standard approval threshold (5%) vs one-time clearance cap (10%).
